payload.next: Finish regression/types/UI recovery checks; prepare reviewed relay deployment approval and real Legitate activation. Keep task open until activation gates are met.
payload.summary: Implemented Classic-only same-Legitate-user encrypted online-device media pulls, six canonical host capabilities, verified resumable staging, fenced existing media relink, account opt-in/presence and offline-media UI. Native account policy and complete editor-api regression passed (one pre-existing ignored performance test). Strict packaged relay smoke rejects unverified identities. Browser QA found stale availability on atomic reopen; added canonical refresh of fresh local source bindings while preserving project edits and history. Feature tests passed; broadened verification found checkpoint ordering regression, now fixed and retesting, plus independent Deepseek tool-schema failures under investigation. Synthetic QA media was restored exactly; timeline stayed unchanged. No public relay deployed, no real Legitate linking or physical two-network transfer verified.
